title: the waiting page stops printing "null" on decision cards
why: From shiv's page comments, Oct 28 12:39 CDT (relayed by the orchestrator): every decision card whose options carry no differs marks shows the text "null". Cause: c122's difkey line in skills/waiting-page/page.html passes null to card.append, and the DOM prints it as text. Reproduced headless on c146-exact-numbers, c95-step2-bar, the d4 items and others.
note: Fix in skills/waiting-page/page.html: append the differs key only when it exists. Red first: a page test that renders a decision item with no differs marks and finds no "null" text. Needs no answer. Port: yes, the skill installs on every repo's page. Placed ahead of c186 and c135 (triage 11, Oct 28): a visible defect on shiv's live page, from c122. Green and reviewed (approve): draft PR #778, e1794be; joins the batch after #746. After it merges, triage republishes the waiting page from main (c130's rule). Merged in batch 13, PR #787 (main 60216ac9), Oct 28 16:22 CDT (lane PR #778). Done; the waiting-page template can now be republished.
